description.value: Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort is one of BC's oldest resorts, established in 1904 on a remote fly-fishing lake about 45 minutes from Kamloops. The resort offers rustic log cabins with cast iron wood cook stoves, RV and tent camping, and lists biking among its summer activities. Access requires 14.6 km on a dirt road with no cell service available on site.

address.value: 9608 Knouff Lake Road, Heffley Creek, BC V0E 1Z1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record 'Lake Front' corresponds to the 'Lakefront' cabin, one of many cabins at Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort, established 1904 near Kamloops. The website confirms the resort is active and lists biking as a summer activity, but provides no information about bike storage or cycling-specific services. Wi-Fi is confirmed available at the Lodge only. Access requires 14.6 km of dirt road (Knouff Lake Rd), and the resort has no cell service, making this a very remote location for touring cyclists.
